title: SHAP model tests: save with serialize_model_using_mlflow=False to exercise the SHAP pickle guard instead of sklearn's
answers: How do I write a test that checks SHAP explainer loading is blocked when pickle deserialization is disabled?
Why does my SHAP load test still pass after removing the SHAP pickle guard?
How do I save a SHAP explainer without the sklearn serialization path in tests?
body:
Path: tests/shap/test_log.py covers mlflow.shap.save_explainer and load paths; the shap_model fixture is sklearn-backed, so default saves route loading through the sklearn loader.
Rule: To test the SHAP-side guard, call mlflow.shap.save_explainer(..., serialize_model_using_mlflow=False) so the load goes straight to mlflow/shap/__init__.py:_load_explainer, then set MLFLOW_ALLOW_PICKLE_DESERIALIZATION to false with monkeypatch.setenv and assert MlflowException matches 'MLFLOW_ALLOW_PICKLE_DESERIALIZATION'. Parametrize over mlflow.shap.load_explainer and pyfunc.load_model to cover both entry points.
Symptom: A guard test passed even with the guard removed, because the sklearn loader's own guard raised first.
Constraints: Use this pattern only for checks on the SHAP loader. For sklearn-specific guard tests, keep the default save path.
applies: Tests for mlflow.shap save/load guards in tests/shap.
says: SHAP security check tests falsely pass even when the guard has been removed.
Security verification for SHAP explainer loading is masked by another model loader check.
Ensure SHAP deserialization safety tests specifically verify the native SHAP loader.
Test that loading a SHAP explainer is blocked when pickle deserialization is disabled.
search: In tests/shap/test_log.py, testing the SHAP pickle deserialization guard in mlflow/shap/__init__.py:_load_explainer requires saving explainers with serialize_model_using_mlflow=False. Tests must set MLFLOW_ALLOW_PICKLE_DESERIALIZATION to false with monkeypatch.setenv, assert MlflowException matches the flag name, and parametrize over mlflow.shap.load_explainer and pyfunc.load_model. This prevents the default sklearn-backed shap_model fixture from routing through the sklearn loader guard and masking a removed SHAP guard. Use this pattern exclusively for SHAP loader checks while keeping default save paths for sklearn tests.
